name: clip4
description: DIY/assembly clip: choosing a screwdriver bit from a green bit case, fitting it into a cordless drill, then driving a screw into a wooden plank. Three Pexels clips joined, ElevenLabs narration placed at the moments the actions happen.

lines.text: Okay, all the bits live in this.
You want one from right here.

expected.referent: the row of small bits in the case where the fingers are
alternatives: a slot in the bit case

expected.referent: the strip of screwdriver bits pulled from the case

lines.text: This part always takes me ages.

expected.referent: (not visual: refers to the step of choosing)
a single screwdriver bit taken off the strip
the chuck of the green cordless drill

lines.text: Twist it like this till it's tight.

expected.referent: twisting the drill's chuck by hand to lock the bit in
(not visual: refers to fitting the bit)
the screw standing in the pale wooden plank next to the gloved hand
alternatives: the spot on the plank by the glove

expected.referent: a gloved hand pressing the plank flat
alternatives: holding the plank steady with a gloved hand

lines.text: Then drive it in slowly, like that.

expected.referent: the drill driving the screw down into the plank
alternatives: screwing into the wood with the drill

lines.text: That's really all there is to it.
